note: Splav's own product page for the Gorka-1 reinforced suit. The mass is the maker's answer in the customer Q&A, not a specification table, and it states its size basis verbatim: size 60 at height 182. A garment mass without a size basis is not usable, so the basis is recorded in the item state and in the locator. The held bytes are the page as served; the digest is of those bytes.
